units: pixels (x right, y down, full-resolution 1920x1080) and seconds; no metric scale

camera.evidence: phase correlation of the lower image band vs frame 0 gives |shift| < 0.02 px at all tested frames; background-difference mask contains only the cyclist (bunting, lamps, trees do not move)
camera.perspective: street scene viewed along the road; vanishing point of the road ~ (1000, 590), horizon ~ y 590. The cyclist rides ACROSS the road (left to right, parallel to the image plane) along the far white stop line at y ~705, so it stays at one depth: its pixel size is constant (length 163 px, height 163 px) and its vertical position constant -> treat as 2D motion with one px scale.

cyclist.description: the only moving object: a person in green jacket, light blue/white helmet with orange back, orange/brown shorts, yellow basket/bag on handlebar, riding a light-pink/white bicycle with black tyres; rides left -> right
cyclist.visible_frames: 0-79 (all); frames 0-5 cut by left image edge (enters from x=0), frames 14-33 rear/lower part behind the near-left black iron fence and lamp pole, frames 76-79 front wheel behind traffic-light pole (x 1650-1672)
cyclist.reference_point: ref_x/ref_y = midpoint of the two wheel hubs (proxy for the bike root/centre). pelvis_est = rear hub + (44, -46) px (hip on saddle, estimated on frame 60). All candidate points move with the same velocity.
cyclist.motion: uniform straight horizontal motion over the whole clip: x_rear_hub = -92.6 + 21.015*frame, x_front_hub = 2.3 + 21.023*frame (px; residual std 0.6-0.8 px over 44 cleanly measured frames); front bbox edge x1 slope 21.07 px/frame; rear edge x0 slope 20.96 px/frame. y constant (hubs at y 705-707). ~21.0 px/frame = ~504 px/s.

pixel_size_unoccluded.note: length range 158-168 in clean frames; height 161-164; shadow on ground below/behind is excluded

static_objects.road: asphalt street running away from camera toward vanishing point ~(1000,590); yellow solid double centre line from ~(985,600) to ~(1120,1080) plus yellow dashed line just left of it ((990,600)->(1090,1080)); white edge lines on both sides
static_objects.stop_line_far: white horizontal line across the road at y ~705, x ~600-1400 (cyclist's wheels hubs ride along it); road width along it ~ x 650 -> 1390 (~740 px) at the cyclist's depth (approximate, edges partly hidden)
static_objects.near_left_fence: black iron spiked fence, foreground left, x 0-600, top of posts from y ~640 (far end) to ~740 (x~90); occludes cyclist frames 14-33
static_objects.far_left_fence: small dark picket fence behind cyclist at far left, y ~635-700, x 0-560
static_objects.right_fence: black iron fence foreground right, x 1700-1920, y ~670-800; picket fence along houses y 630-700
static_objects.traffic_light_pole: black pole right, x 1652-1672, from y ~120 (top/arm) to ~760 (base on pavement); signal head x ~1655-1680, y ~515-580 with red light lit at ~(1668,532); occludes cyclist front wheel frames 76-79
static_objects.building_left: dark multi-storey building with red neon shop front, x ~330-690, y ~90-640; lit shop windows x 400-650, y 500-640
static_objects.houses_right: row of white/stone houses with dark roofs, x ~1220-1920, y ~350-700
static_objects.bunting: three strings of red and white triangular flags: near string across top of frame (y 0-190), middle string x 710-1365 y 310-400, far string x 830-1200 y 400-475; static
static_objects.sidewalks: pavement/curb on both sides; right sidewalk near y 700-800 at x 1400-1920

events.event: cyclist enters frame at left edge (already moving)
cyclist passes behind near-left fence/lamp pole
cyclist crosses image centre x=960 (ref point)
clip ends with cyclist still moving (still in frame, ref x ~1615)

events.note: no start/stop, bounce, impact or direction change; speed constant throughout
